entries.test: Whether AGI meeting the endorsed definition of human cognitive capabilities across all domains, including breakthrough creativity and physical intelligence, first arrives during 2031–2036.
entries.note: Marcus explicitly adopts the conservative estimate in his own voice. His '100%' endorsement supports a firm forecast rather than the drafter's 'likely' modality.

entries.test: Public demonstrations of current systems' breakthrough creativity across domains and physical capabilities, and whether any system meets the endorsed AGI definition before January 1, 2030.
entries.note: The principal commitment is no AGI through 2029. The accompanying assessment of current capability gaps can be evaluated now.
